answer: Sponsor liability makes every new key carry its sponsors' losses. A key joins only if 3 relics, keys older than 60 days with a clean record, each lock 200 POA for 30 days in the jade, a public sponsorship registry. Each epoch a gale audit samples 10% of new keys; a failed audit burns all 3 sponsor locks, so sponsors stop vouching for unverified keys. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 locked sponsor slots. Attacker pays about 600,000 POA in locks this epoch, forfeited when audited.
